label: Our process
title: From the first conversation to long after launch.
intro: How we move from a business problem to working software, and keep it working.
imageAlt: A team mapping out a project on a wall of sticky notes

steps.name: Discover
steps.text: We start with the business problem: the people, the workflow and what success should look like. Nothing gets built until we understand why it matters.

steps.name: Define
steps.text: We agree on scope, priorities and the architecture that fits your scale and budget, so everyone knows what is being built and in what order.

steps.name: Design
steps.text: We shape interfaces and flows that feel obvious to the people who will use them every day.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: We engineer in focused iterations, so you see working software early and often, and can steer as we go.

steps.name: Test
steps.text: We check functionality, performance and security before anything reaches your users.

steps.name: Launch & support
steps.text: We deploy, monitor and keep improving, so your system stays healthy as you grow.

foundations.label: Engineering foundations
foundations.title: The disciplines behind every build.
foundations.intro: Each project draws on the same core disciplines, combined for what your business needs.

rows.text: Web, mobile and desktop applications designed for everyday use.
Connections to payment providers, third-party services and the systems you already run.
Database design, reporting and analysis that turn records into decisions.
Cloud deployment, SaaS and multi-tenant architecture, and system integrations.
Intelligent assistants, AI-powered workflows and automated processes.
Testing for functionality, performance and security before release.
Maintenance, monitoring and technical support after launch.
